title: Wazuh Alert Manager: an alert-triage and case-management workbench for security operations centres
description: An OpenSearch Dashboards plugin that turns Wazuh alerts into a security operations workbench: an alert lifecycle (open / in progress / closed) with assignment and audit history, investigative cases with an attack-path graph and MITRE kill-chain view, and a trigger/action automation engine that escalates alert bursts into cases and auto-closes or auto-assigns routine alerts, with deterministic triage aids (precedent and suggested related alerts) and per-analyst reporting. Supports Wazuh 4.12, 4.13 and 4.14.
